title: Parkio Daily for October 21, 2026
teaser: Buzz Lightyear facade refresh complete at Disneyland; Polynesian construction extended into 2027; two new Jollywood Nights characters announced.

rides.name: Space Mountain
rides.note: Early morning windows tend to offer sub-20 minute waits

rides.name: Soarin'
rides.note: Dinner hour typically brings walk-on opportunities

rides.name: Buzz Lightyear Astro Blasters
rides.note: Fresh facade reveal complete, attraction running normally

bignews.title: Buzz Lightyear Astro Blasters exterior refresh complete at Disneyland
bignews.body: The scrim and construction walls that covered part of the Tomorrowland attraction since early September have been removed, revealing updated facade work.

parkioInsight.text: The freshened exterior typically draws curious guests mid-morning. Riding before 10am or after dinner usually avoids the curiosity bump.

bignews.title: Polynesian Village Resort construction now expected to run into 2027
bignews.body: An updated refurbishment bulletin shows work on one of Walt Disney World's largest hotel projects will continue past the holiday season, extending into the new year.

parkioInsight.text: Guests with Polynesian reservations through early 2027 may encounter ongoing noise and visual disruptions. Consider requesting rooms furthest from active work zones when checking in.

bignews.title: Two additional characters confirmed for Jollywood Nights at Hollywood Studios
bignews.body: Disney quietly announced two new character meet opportunities for the holiday after-hours event, though specific names have not yet been disclosed.

parkioInsight.text: New character debuts at special events tend to draw lines within the first hour. Arriving at event start and heading directly to meet locations usually shortens waits significantly.

bignews.title: Character meet location moving inside Hollywood Studios
bignews.body: A popular character greeting spot is relocating within the park, though Disney has not yet announced the new position or effective date.

parkioInsight.text: Character meet relocations often create confusion for a few days. Checking the My Disney Experience app for live character locations this week can save backtracking.

topstories.title: Brooks reveals 2026 Wine & Dine Half Marathon Weekend running shoes
topstories.body: The official athletic footwear partner has unveiled commemorative shoe designs for the November race weekend at Walt Disney World.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-edition race merchandise typically sells fastest at the EPCOT expo before race morning. Shopping the first expo session often secures popular sizes.

topstories.title: Winnie the Pooh 100th anniversary products now available across Disney Parks
topstories.body: A collection celebrating the character's centennial has arrived at locations in Walt Disney World and Disneyland, featuring apparel, accessories, and collectibles.

parkioInsight.text: Anniversary merchandise tends to move quickly at flagship shops like Emporium and World of Disney. Stopping by within the first two hours of park opening usually offers the fullest selection.

topstories.title: Veterans Day merchandise collection debuts at Walt Disney World and Disneyland
topstories.body: Disney's 2026 collection honoring military service members is now available at select resort locations ahead of the November 11 holiday.

parkioInsight.text: Patriotic collections often see strong demand from annual passholders and local guests. Visiting on a weekday morning tends to offer better stock and shorter checkout lines.

topstories.title: Crystal Arts releases 2026 advent calendar and ornament trees at Disneyland Resort
topstories.body: The Arribas Brothers holiday collection, including a $399 house-shaped advent calendar with gold foil details, is now on sale at resort locations.

parkioInsight.text: High-end holiday collectibles from Crystal Arts are produced in limited quantities. Purchasing within the first week of availability usually ensures selection before sellouts.

topstories.title: 40% discount on select 2026-dated merchandise at Disneyland Resort
topstories.body: Year-specific pins, ornaments, photo frames, and autograph books are now on sale as the calendar year winds down.

parkioInsight.text: Year-end clearance sales accelerate as November approaches. Shopping this week typically offers better variety than waiting until December when inventory thins out.

topstories.title: Mickey Fair Isle holiday bags and Minnie ears arrive at Disney Store
topstories.body: A new seasonal collection featuring traditional Fair Isle patterns has launched, including coordinating accessories and holiday headwear.

parkioInsight.text: Holiday-themed ears and bags often sell out online within days of launch. Ordering early this week or visiting a Disney Store location in person usually secures items before stock runs low.

topstories.title: Fuzzy sherpa Mickey bucket hats and caps now at Disneyland Resort
topstories.body: Cold-weather headwear featuring white sherpa fabric and attached Mickey ears has arrived at resort shops ahead of the season shift.

parkioInsight.text: Seasonal headwear tends to be most available during the first two weeks after debut. Evening temperatures in Southern California can drop into the 50s, making these practical for late park hours.

icymi.title: Carol Choi named Disney Asia Pacific president as Luke Kang retires
icymi.body: The Walt Disney Company announced that current APAC executive VP Carol Choi will succeed 16-year president Luke Kang at year-end.

icymi.title: Banana Ball announces 2027 return to Walt Disney World
icymi.body: The Savannah Bananas revealed dates and venues for next year's tour during a live ESPN2 broadcast, confirming the sports entertainment event will return to the resort.

icymi.title: Disney Parks Blog introduces S.E.A. member Hazel Hightower
icymi.body: The Society of Explorers and Adventurers storyline expands with a new character, part of an ongoing narrative across multiple Disney attractions worldwide.

icymi.title: Retired CEO Bob Iger announces new book about second Disney tenure
icymi.body: Iger's upcoming title, One Last Time, will cover his return as chief executive and extend the ongoing public narrative with former CEO Bob Chapek.

spotlight.title: New plant-based dish earns strong marks at EPCOT
spotlight.body: Disney Food Blog reviewed a recently added vegan entrée and gave it high praise, noting flavor and presentation that competes well with traditional menu options.

parkioInsight.text: Plant-based options at World Showcase pavilions tend to be less ordered than meat-based dishes, often resulting in faster prep times during peak lunch and dinner rushes. Worth trying if you're looking to avoid longer waits at popular quick-service windows.
